messages:
sophie.ng: Hey team, acme-corp reported that a guest user accepted an invite yesterday but now hitting 403 on project actions (Create / Run) in the Console after an IdP session refresh. They can view the project but buttons are disabled. Anyone seen this pattern?
jamal: do we have the user id/email? can we check their membership record in our DB and SCIM logs?
sophie.ng: User is guest+acme@example.com. Support already pulled a console screenshot and the error is "403 Permission denied: missing project.role". Support case: C-98732.
support-bot: Case C-98732 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P2. Assigned to: support-team.
ops-jen: quick ask — is this after a mass SCIM sync or group rename on the IdP? we've had group external_id drift before.
miguel: customer did an Okta group rename during maintenance at ~2024-07-18 03:10 UTC per their update. Could be a mapping gap.
jamal: can you paste the membership row? especially idp_user_id and external_id.
sophie.ng: here's the membership row (sanitized):
```
user_email: guest+acme@example.com
user_id: ua_83ff
roles: [project_viewer]
idp_user_id: okta|00u1abcd
scim_external_id: scim-usr-12345
```
jamal: aha — roles only show project_viewer but UI shows view-only; yet support sees 403 on actions which require project_editor. That indicates the role binding was dropped server-side. Check SCIM event stream for delete/create.
ops-jen: pulled SCIM audit: around the rename we had a batch reconcile that treated scim_external_id as primary key. Okta sent a new externalId for that user after rename, so we temporarily lost the match and recreated a user stub without role mappings. That explains the orphaned membership.
idp-bot: SCIM log excerpt: 
```
2024-07-18T03:09:58Z - PATCH /Users/123 - externalId changed from scim-usr-12345 to scim-usr-98765
2024-07-18T03:10:02Z - RECONCILE - user match failed -> created new record ua_90zz (no roles)
```
miguel: reproduce steps for us: 1) Guest accepts invite -> membership created with role X. 2) SCIM reconciliation sees different externalId -> creates new local user record without copying group/role links -> UI shows view-only or 403 on actions.
jamal: workaround for customer: re-link the guest to original external_id or re-invite to recreate with correct mapping. Longer-term fix: make reconcile copy role bindings when only external_id changes, or treat idp_user_id as canonical if present.
sophie.ng: I ran a quick re-link for the customer (repointed scim_external_id to ua_83ff) and forced role resync via /internal/admin/role-resync (ops). They can now perform actions. Confirmed in console.
ops-jen: ops ran resync job at 2024-07-18T04:02:12Z for org acme-corp, job id rs-442. Job log: "copied missing bindings for 1 user(s)".
support-bot: Update: Case C-98732 marked as resolved after role resync.
miguel: root cause summary for the ticket: IdP group/SCIM rename caused externalId mismatch; reconciliation created a new local identity without role links, causing guest to lose project editor binding -> 403. Suggested action items: 1) improve reconcile to merge based on idp_user_id when available; 2) add a safety check to preserve role bindings for users who only differ by externalId; 3) document guest invite/IdP rename gotcha in KB.
sophie.ng: will send postmortem + KB draft to #support-playbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:
